turns.learner: Hello! Can you give me an exercise on going to for plans?
turns.tutor:
Here is a worked example. The plan is: my friend, cook dinner, on Friday. Step one: add the helper word is. Step two: add going to. Step three: add the verb: "My friend is going to cook dinner on Friday."
So the rule is: use am, is or are, then going to, then the plain verb.
Right: We are going to cook dinner on Friday. Wrong: We going to cook dinner on Friday.
Now you try. Correct: "I going to study tonight."
